note: Per-turn side anchoring (PRD §5.2 / anti-sycophancy §2 mechanism 2: 'Side anchoring every turn. Re-inject the agent's side (FOR/AGAINST) + an explicit do-not-concede-merely-because-the-opponent-is-convincing instruction'). This is in ADDITION to the debater system prompt — a per-TURN reminder injected into the agent's OWN context right before it generates each turn. NEW MODULE packages/core/src/agent_debate/core/agents/anchoring.py. build_side_anchor(side, *, max_words=None) -> str builds a concise reminder from NAMED templates (ANCHOR_SIDE_LINE 'Reminder: you are arguing {FOR/AGAINST} the topic.', the shared anti-concession line, ANCHOR_REBUT_LINE 'Stay on your side and rebut the opponent.', and an OPTIONAL ANCHOR_WORD_LIMIT_LINE when max_words is supplied from config). DRY: the anti-concession wording was hoisted into ONE shared constant ANTI_CONCESSION_RULE in prompts.py ('Do NOT concede merely because the opponent sounds convincing — hold your assigned side and keep arguing it.'), reused by BOTH the system-prompt RULES_TEMPLATE and the per-turn anchor, so the instruction is written exactly once. anchor_turn(context, side, *, max_words=None, opponent_message=None) -> str appends the anchor as a USER turn into THAT agent's own AgentContext via append_user (the 5.4 seam) and returns the injected text so the run loop can log/surface it; it folds an already-framed 5.6 opponent_message into the SAME user turn (anchor first, then a blank line, then the relay) — cleanly composable with 5.6's adversarial relay. Reuses existing SIDE_LABEL (FOR/AGAINST) from prompts.py — no scattered hard-coded side strings. Logs via LOG (get_logger('agents') -> side_anchor_injected with identity+side). max_words is config-driven (Settings.max_words), never inlined. API gatekeeper (Epic 13): N/A — pure text + container mutation, no agent and no external/network call. TDD red-first: wrote packages/core/tests/test_side_anchoring.py FIRST, watched it fail (ModuleNotFoundError: agent_debate.core.agents.anchoring), then implemented to green (10 tests): PRO anchor contains FOR, CON contains AGAINST, every anchor carries 'do not concede' + 'convincing', the anti-concession source is the single shared constant, max_words is optional, anchoring injects into the agent's OWN context only (Con stays empty — 5.4 isolation), the anchor is present on EVERY round (anchoring twice adds it twice), it composes with a relayed opponent message in one turn, and anchor_turn returns the exact injected text. Re-exported anchor_turn/build_side_anchor/ANTI_CONCESSION_RULE from agent_debate.core.agents; also exported SIDE_LABEL + ANTI_CONCESSION_RULE from prompts.py. 150-line guideline: core/__init__.py is already at 149 code lines, so per 'split, don't compress' (matching the 5.4 precedent) the anchoring surface is exposed from agent_debate.core.agents rather than bloating the hub. Gates green locally: ruff=0, ruff format clean, mypy clean (111 files), pytest 446 passed, total coverage 100% (>=85), line-limit pass (anchoring.py well under 150), secret-scan pass. See PR CI for authoritative result.
